name: Shadowglen
summary: Young night elves begin their training in Shadowglen, beneath the boughs of Teldrassil. The vale gathers around Aldrassil, where elders, priestesses, and mentors guide them before they travel farther into the world.

sections.title: A Sheltered Cradle
sections.body: Shadowglen lies beneath the northeastern boughs of Teldrassil, ringed by high ridges that shelter it from the rest of the world. Eternal dusk falls over the vale, where Aldrassil rises as a massive barrow-tree. Its hollowed trunk houses elders, priestesses, and mentors who guide young night elves beginning their training. A narrow mountain pass leads south toward Starbreeze Village and Dolanaar. This single route out leaves the sanctuary sheltered and peaceful.

sections.title: Creeping Shadows
sections.body: Danger reaches even this sheltered vale. Shadowthread Cave lies in the extreme northwest, where venomous spiders threaten the glade. Young defenders drive back the encroaching vermin and untamed wildlife before venturing farther among Teldrassil's boughs.

faq.answer: Shadowglen is where young night elves begin their training in northeastern Teldrassil. In the vale, elders, priestesses, and mentors guide them beneath the great barrow-tree Aldrassil.

faq.q: What is the massive tree at the center of the glen?
faq.answer: Aldrassil is the barrow-tree at the heart of Shadowglen. Its hollowed trunk houses elders, priestesses, and mentors who guide young night elves in training.
Venomous spiders in Shadowthread Cave threaten Shadowglen from the extreme northwest. Young defenders also face untamed wildlife in the glade.
A narrow mountain pass leads south out of Shadowglen toward Starbreeze Village and Dolanaar.

angles.text: As a night elf, you begin your training in Shadowglen beneath Aldrassil, then face the wider world beyond the vale.
As an Alliance traveler, you find Shadowglen high among Teldrassil's boughs, sheltered behind guarded ports.
